title: Guided tour in French of the Super Heroes
includes: Post-visit sheet with all our good addresses
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Accompanied by our French guides who have been living in New York for years, come and discover Midtown and Brooklyn under the eye of superheroes.
It's a best-selling visit, ideal for families, which appeals to both adults and children and which will immerse you in the references of your favorite heroes,.... while making you discover the mythical streets and buildings of New York.
